results.name: Shamy & Shamy, LLC

wrong_claims.claim: agent_readiness notes state there is 'no hours in text' on the site
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Hours are published as plain text in the home page footer: 'Hours of Operation: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sat-Sun Closed'. They are readable text, just not marked up in schema.

results.notes: TLS failure is real and reproducible: the browser shows the full-page 'Your connection is not private' interstitial, and an HTTPS request without a bypass fails with 'certificate verify failed: self-signed certificate'. I could only read the site after telling the browser to ignore certificate errors. Home page confirmed: title 'Law Office - New Brunswick, NJ - Shamy & Shamy, LLC.', h1 'Litigation Lawyers in New Brunswick, New Jersey', 0 JSON-LD blocks, 0 form inputs on the page (only a Thryv 'Let's Talk / Leave details' gate in an iframe), one tel: link, ~2,533 characters of body text. At 390 px the document scrolls to 768 px: the logo is cut off at the left edge and nav items run off the right edge - mobile claim confirmed. Google Maps place confirms 4.0 rating, category 'Attorney' and no photos (only an 'Add photos & videos' prompt). robots.txt is permissive (User-agent: * plus sitemap). Scores as recorded are reasonable.

results.name: M&Y International Financial Services
results.notes: Re-verified page by page. Home: title 'M&Y International Financial Services | New Brunswick | NJ | Home'; footer '(c) 2012 M&Y International LLC'; banner still '2019 Individual & Business Tax Highlights'; promo 'Tax Refund Advance ... Starts as Early as January 3, 2023'; 0 form inputs and 0 tel: links anywhere checked; a link to /book-online is present. JSON-LD is exactly two blocks: LocalBusiness (address 193 Livingston Avenue, telephone +732-640-5088, no openingHours, no services, no priceRange) and WebSite. /new-client-questionnaire is effectively blank (262 characters: contact e-mail/address/phone plus footer, no form). /book-online shows three genuinely bookable free slots - 30 min, 1 hr, 2 hr - with Book Now buttons. /pricing-for-accounting-bookkeeping lists service modules and a 10% new-customer discount but contains no dollar amounts. robots.txt allows all, blocks PetalBot, gives dotbot/AhrefsBot a crawl delay and lists a sitemap. Our-team page names four people (Mars Mellish DBA/CFO, Franmi Perez, Aldin Cameron, Louis Marotta). At 390 px the layout viewport expands to 1036 px and the firm name and cards are cut off horizontally - mobile claim confirmed. Not in the record: a Google Business Profile does exist (4.8, category 'Accountant', 193 Livingston Ave, open to 6 PM, no photos). On the score, gap_size 5 looks overstated for the one record in this set that already has working online booking plus accurate LocalBusiness schema and a 4.8 profile; I would set gap_size 4 and leave the rest.

results.name: Samuel S. Fisher & Associates CPA, LLC
results.notes: Confirmed exactly as recorded. AccountingService JSON-LD is present and accurate (name, 100 Bayard St Suite 311, telephone 732-846-1700). The header phone is an anchor with href="732-846-1700" - a relative URL, not a tel: link - so tap-to-call is broken. Fetching /about-us.html, /contact.html, /attorney-services.html, /business-services.html, /service-area.html, /news.html, /articles.html and /clients-referrals.html all return 200 from the homepage URL with identical length (5,188 bytes), i.e. they silently serve '/'. No hours anywhere in the page text. Contact does exist as an embedded third-party form iframe (njypprojects.com form-builder, id 133489), matching 'contact_form: true', and the page is responsive at 390 px. Birdeye profile re-checked: 3.7 from 3 reviews, 'This profile has not been claimed', and it shows Mon-Fri 9:00-5:30 hours that the firm's own site never publishes. Scores reasonable.

results.name: Professional Land Services Inc. (NJ Professional Land Services)

wrong_claims.claim: status: 'operating' (and listing rating '4.7' sourced to landsurveyors.directory, described as claiming to mirror Google)
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Google Maps shows 'PROFESSIONAL LAND SERVICES, INC' at 7 Stratford Pl, New Brunswick NJ 08901 - the exact address and website shown on the site - flagged 'Permanently closed', with a 4.7 rating, phone (908) 693-0175 and 'Posting is currently turned off'. The cited directory no longer exists as a directory: landsurveyors.directory now resolves to a parked domain-for-sale listing (ExpiredDomains/GoDaddy), so that source does not support the 4.7 rating.

results.notes: The website audit itself is accurate on every point I re-checked: an HTTPS request fails with 'certificate verify failed: self-signed certificate' (I had to bypass the interstitial to read the page); footer '(c) Copyright 2024'; no form and no inputs anywhere; the 'Fax: (732) 249-1754' anchor has href="tel: (732) 249-1400" so it dials the main line; no JSON-LD; no meta description; robots.txt and sitemap.xml both 404; titles are 'NJ Professional Land Services' / 'NJ Pro Land Surveyor' with no town; home page says 'over 30 years' while the contact page says 'over 40 years'; scripts load from cdn.rawgit.com and a dead Universal Analytics tag UA-3604312-51 is still wired in; a weather widget sits in the footer; contact gives only phone, fax, text and a personal att.net address. What changes the record is the status: the Google profile for this exact business is marked permanently closed, which fits the dormant site (no update signals since roughly 2019-2021). I could not place a call, so trading has not been proven to have stopped, but a closed Google profile plus the address and website match is enough to pull this record from the ranking until someone confirms by phone. Scores are therefore not corrected - if the firm is trading, the recorded 5/2/4/5 is fair; if it has closed, the record should be dropped.

data_gaps: Google Maps 'limited view' never showed review counts, so review totals for Shamy & Shamy, New Brunswick Property Management, MarMar and M&Y remain unconfirmed (the ratings themselves were confirmed: 4.0, 5.0, 5.0, 4.8).

Professional Land Services: Google's 'Permanently closed' label could not be corroborated independently - no phone call is permitted in this task and the NJ Division of Consumer Affairs licence report was not opened. Treat as 'verify before ranking' rather than certain closure.
